attachments.origin_landmark: pyramidal eminence on the posterior wall of the tympanic cavity

actions: tilts the stapes, reducing the amplitude of ossicular vibration

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: The smallest skeletal muscle in the body. Because its nerve leaves the facial nerve inside the facial canal, a facial palsy proximal to that branch adds HYPERACUSIS to the weakness -- which is how the lesion is localised above or below the stapedial branch.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
